objective: Make Ron System a zero-credential single-user interface: possession of the canonical System Core URL is sufficient for full PWA/API access from any device, with no bearer token, password, login, device session or authentication gate, while preserving the System event owner, action validation, idempotency, evidence/gameplay rules, projection behavior and rollback provenance.

roles_before.artifact: SYSTEM_BEARER_TOKEN plus signed device-session cookie gates all /api routes.
PWA can prompt for a bearer token, exchange it for a signed HttpOnly session, and expose disconnect/session controls.
Non-browser clients authenticate with Authorization: Bearer before using the System API.
Cookie-authenticated writes require same-origin/PWA proof; bearer clients bypass that browser-specific check.
Docker production entrypoint runs audit-gateway.mjs, which requires SYSTEM_BEARER_TOKEN and selectively injects it for visual-audit snapshot reads.
audit.html plus audit-loader.js provide a browser-side read-only visual audit surface.
Neon system_events is the sole mutable owner of derived RPG state; PWA is a projection/action surface.
Idempotency keys, action/schema validation, PostgreSQL action gate and System evidence/gameplay policies constrain valid mutations.
Russian-first PWA, deadline automation, notifications and opted-in Web Push operate independently of player-state ownership.
Prior authenticated implementation is recoverable from Git history and deployment rollback.

role_dispositions.rationale: Ron explicitly selected URL-only access for this personal System.
role_dispositions.consequence: System Core no longer requires caller credentials; existing action-integrity rules remain unchanged.

role_dispositions.rationale: Per-device login is incompatible with the requested open-by-URL experience.
role_dispositions.consequence: Fresh devices load System directly without login/logout state.

role_dispositions.destination: Controllers and automation clients call the same canonical API directly with no authentication header.

role_dispositions.rationale: The selected access model no longer uses session identity as an authorization source.
role_dispositions.consequence: Write acceptance is determined by the unchanged System action-integrity and policy gates rather than caller-session identity.

role_dispositions.rationale: Its bearer-dependent proxy layer would preserve the credential dependency after the backend auth gate was removed and is redundant under URL-only access.
role_dispositions.consequence: The production Docker image starts server-v2.mjs directly; selective bearer injection and gateway-level access filtering no longer exist.

role_dispositions.destination: audit.html and audit-loader.js remain a read-only browser UI; its client-side write interception remains available for visual auditing.
Neon system_events remains the sole mutable owner; PWA remains projection/action surface only.
Idempotency, action validation, database gate, evidence requirements and gameplay policy remain unchanged and continue to reject invalid mutations.
Russian UI, deadline automation, notifications, Web Push and offline shell behavior remain functional without login state.
Git history preserves the removed bearer/session/audit-gateway implementation; rollback requires no data migration.

capability_probes.assertion: A fresh client with no Authorization header and no cookie can read capabilities and the full snapshot.
A credential-free client can execute an otherwise policy-valid action through the unchanged action gate using the required Idempotency-Key.
Server and production Docker image start without SYSTEM_BEARER_TOKEN and PWA contains no required token/session bootstrap path.
Removing authentication does not bypass action shape, idempotency, evidence, lifecycle or PostgreSQL validation.
Quest/profile/progression projection, deadline automation, notification acknowledgement, visual audit UI and Web Push tests remain passing.
The exact prior bearer/session/audit-gateway implementation remains recoverable from base SHA 5c3c229efd7e4a62e579adc033e2da07c358f6ac and Git history.

tests.expected: PASS: direct server and production Docker image start without SYSTEM_BEARER_TOKEN; anonymous capabilities/snapshot return 200; no login/session credential is required.
PASS: PWA loads immediately from URL and contains no required password/bearer/session interaction.
PASS: mutation validation and idempotency are unchanged.

known_intentional_losses: No confidentiality boundary for System data at the canonical URL.
No authentication-derived protection against a direct client that knows the canonical URL and intentionally calls mutation endpoints.
No bearer-injecting audit gateway in the production request path.

verification.ci_evidence: system-cloud-ci #454 on d311417 (model/Postgres/Docker), system-pwa-ci #271 on a01d8f6, continuity-guard #1502/#1503; the a01 delta from d311 only restored the pre-existing reward-architecture PWA workflow trigger.
verification.authorization: Ron explicitly required URL-only full System access from any device and explicitly requested removal of bearer tokens, passwords, login/session gates and equivalent access-control barriers. Integrity/action-policy gates are out of scope for removal because they validate System commands rather than identify the caller.
